rules.title: California Fair Housing: Protected Characteristics in Housing Discrimination
rules.requirement: Housing providers cannot discriminate against applicants or tenants based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information. Housing providers cannot make written or oral inquiries about these protected characteristics, publish discriminatory notices, or aid in discrimination.
rules.quotedSpan: It shall be unlawful: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental housing in California.
warnings: Section 12955(p)(2) permits inquiry into level or source of income (though not refusal based on source).
Retaliation for opposing unlawful practices or cooperating with enforcement is prohibited under subsection (f).
Subsection (n) requires aggregation of income for unmarried cohabitants on same basis as married couples.

rules.title: California Fair Housing: Housing Subsidies and Credit History
rules.requirement: When a tenant receives a government rent subsidy, housing providers cannot use a financial or income standard not based on the tenant's portion of rent, and cannot use credit history as the sole screening method; applicants must be offered the option to provide verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay the tenant's portion (such as government benefits, pay records, or bank statements), and the provider must reasonably consider that evidence.
rules.quotedSpan: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant. (B) Use a person's credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option...of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant's reasonable ability to pay the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant
rules.coverageDescription: All rental housing in California where the tenant receives a government rent subsidy.
exemptions: Does not limit verification of employment, landlord references, or identity verification.
warnings: This rule applies only when there is a government rent subsidy (such as Section 8 vouchers).
Housing providers may still inquire about level or source of income under subsection (p)(2).
Source GOV § 12955 covers fair housing discrimination broadly; rules recorded address screening_restrictions category only.
Effective date is 2024-01-01 per amendment by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776 (SB 267); does not cover future applicability.
Text does not establish coverage conditions by building characteristics; coverage is statewide to all residential rentals.
